name: Full Stack Developer
description: Master modern full-stack web development from HTML/CSS/JS fundamentals to React, Node.js, databases, APIs, and cloud deployment.

levels.title: Web Foundations & JavaScript
levels.description: Semantic HTML5, responsive CSS Grid/Flexbox, modern ES6+ JavaScript, and DOM APIs.

topics.title: Semantic HTML5 & Accessibility
topics.description: ARIA attributes, semantic hierarchy, keyboard navigation, and form validation.

topics.title: Modern CSS (Flexbox, Grid & Tailwind)
topics.description: Box model, responsive breakpoints, Flexbox layouts, Grid systems, and CSS variables.

topics.title: JavaScript ES6+ & Async/Await
topics.description: Promises, async/await, closures, prototypes, destructuring, and Fetch API.

levels.title: Frontend Frameworks (React & Next.js)
levels.description: Components, state management, hooks, routing, server-side rendering, and caching.

topics.title: React Hooks & State Architecture
topics.description: useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback, useRef, custom hooks, and context.

topics.title: Next.js App Router & Server Components
topics.description: React Server Components, server actions, dynamic routing, and caching strategies.

levels.title: Backend Engineering & Node.js
levels.description: RESTful API design with Express/NestJS, middleware, authentication, and security.

topics.title: Express REST API Architecture
topics.description: Routing controllers, middleware pipelines, error handling, and Zod input validation.

topics.title: Authentication & Security (JWT, OAuth)
topics.description: Bcrypt password hashing, JWT cookies, CORS, rate limiting, and RBAC authorization.

levels.title: Databases & ORMs
levels.description: PostgreSQL relational data modeling, indexing, transactions, and Prisma/Drizzle ORM.

topics.title: PostgreSQL & Prisma ORM
topics.description: Schema migrations, relations, complex joins, indexing, and connection pooling.

levels.title: DevOps, CI/CD & Deployment
levels.description: Docker containerization, GitHub Actions automated CI/CD, and deploying to Vercel and AWS.

topics.title: Docker Containers & GitHub Actions CI/CD
topics.description: Multi-stage builds, automated lint/test workflows, and zero-downtime deployments.
